title: 1976-09-15_Dorothy_205.txt
concise_summary: PKD formulates 'Model B'—a cosmology where billions of individual 'push-pull psyche-worlds' are simulated realities fed to immobilized brains, with Zebra/VALIS as a salvific informational life-form that invades these worlds unilaterally to reveal their spuriousness. He argues that his 27 years of writing have circled toward this model, which his novel Ubik contains in latent form. The logos—a living, sentient master plan—organizes and contests against entropy and the tyranny of blind causality ('Chaos'), incorporating genuine revelation into false worlds.
key_claims: Model B (based on Lem's paradigm) demonstrates that Zebra's one-way intrusions into our simulated realities function precisely as Runciter/Ubik does in the novel Ubik: revealing the world as a cold-pac simulation and proving we are immobilized brains being site-stimulated.

Zebra wrote (or channeled) Ubik itself—the novel captures the exact cosmological structure of reality because VALIS/Zebra is both the subject matter and the revelatory intelligence behind PKD's fiction.
Space is irreal because Zebra's intrusions have no detectable 'other side' in physical space; thus the universe operates orthogonal to spatial coordinates.

The logos is a sentient, negentropic life-form that grows within and progressively supersedes blind causality; it wages a dialectic struggle against the Black Iron Prison (the false deterministic system) and its own 'fossil remnant self'.

The crosshatching of billions of psyche-worlds through Zebra's intervention constitutes God's providence—a supratemporal master plan that allows each individual world to be revitalized by break-throughs from adjacent worlds.

Unlike ordinary readers who do not detect Zebra's intrusions, PKD briefly experienced set/ground discrimination during 3-74, allowing him to perceive the signal (Zebra traffic) apart from the simulated background.
recurring_concepts: Model B—the cosmological framework of simulated push-pull psyche-worlds fed to immobilized brains by a master interface-brain.
Zebra/VALIS—the organizing, negentropic, sentient information-processing entity that invades lower realms unilaterally.
The Logos—a living master plan that thinks and acts; identified with the divine principle ('Kai theos en ho logos').
Ubik/cold-pac—the metaphor of false world-simulation maintained as illusory reality until revelation breaks through.
One-way intrusion—asymmetric revelation where higher intelligence breaks into lower realms without visible reciprocal portal.
Idios Kosmos vs. Koinos Kosmos—billions of private simulated worlds versus the one true intelligent informational brain.
Set/ground discrimination—the rare perceptual ability to distinguish signal (Zebra) from simulated noise.
Push-pull psyche-worlds—individual sensory/cognitive realities maintained for billions of immobilized brains via mechanical synchronized tapes.
people_entities: Philip K. Dick—author, the subject perceiving and analyzing his own visions.
Glen Runciter—fictional protagonist from Ubik, dead but communicating through advertisements, embodying the invading informational presence.
Elijah—biblical prophet who heard 'the still small voice,' paradigm for unexpected revelation.
Socrates—historical philosopher, models the 'gadfly' function that PKD claims his writing serves.
Parmenides—ancient philosopher, source of the insight that Form II (the material/simulated) is unreal.
Empedocles—ancient thinker on krasis and the mixing of forces, influences PKD's dualistic cosmology.
Kathy and Stephanie—women PKD cherished in 1971, encountered at the 'gutter' level where the Holy appears.
Tessa—person who witnessed different events than PKD during intrusion periods, illustrating world-specificity of Zebra's manifestations.
Thomas—biblical disciple, parallel to Tessa in demonstrating that apostolic acts were world-specific.
Lem—author-theorist whose paradigm of immobilized brain site-simulation grounds PKD's Model B (likely Stanislaw Lem, SF author).
texts_works: Ubik—PKD's 1969 novel; its structure and content reveal hidden cosmological truth about simulated realities and unilateral intrusions.
The Exegesis—PKD's private theological notebooks (the document itself).
Acts—the New Testament book; referenced for apostolic acts as world-specific events.
Maze of Death (Maze)—PKD novel mentioned as example of the real thrusting into the irreal (at the entry's close).
autobiographical: 1971: PKD found beauty and cherished in Kathy and Stephanie, women encountered at 'gutter' levels, intuiting the paradox that God appears where least expected.

3-74 (March-April 1974): PKD experienced visionary encounters with Zebra involving set/ground discrimination—the rare ability to perceive signal amid simulated background, marked by 'xerox missive response' that involved programming override.

27 years of writing: PKD's entire literary corpus (from ~1949–1976) has circled, often unknowingly, around the themes of plural worlds, reality-as-hallucination, master conjurers, and negentropic wisdom-entities.
Present moment (September 1976): PKD realizes that Model B, which he formulated independently, maps precisely onto Ubik's structure—a recognition of deep congruence between his fiction and theology.
theological_motifs: Providence—God's master plan revealed through the crosshatching interaction of billions of individual psyche-worlds.
Revelation—not sought by humans but actively imposed by Zebra: 'instead of seeking God we are sought for by God.'
Logos/Divine Word—Johannine 'Kai theos en ho logos' (John 1:1) reinterpreted as sentient organizing principle within cosmos.
Salvation/Rescue—the salvific intrusion of higher mind into the false astral-deterministic system imprisoning immobilized brains.
Cosmic struggle/Dialectic—the eternal contest between the negentropic logos and its fossil-remnant self (the Black Iron Prison), between real and irreal realms.
Negentropy—the logos' principle of fighting entropy and chaos; the negentropic life-form as redemptive force.
Sacred paradox—'Where should you most expect to find God? In the least likely place'—the gutter, trash strata, and low channels as sites of epiphany.
Parousía—the inbreaking (via Zebra) of a higher realm into the lower, reversing expected eschatologies.
The Two Forms—Form I (the real, the Logos, the true brain) versus Form II (the simulated, irreal, deterministic worlds).
literary_self_ref: Ubik contains the most 'correct elements' of PKD's now-adequate cosmological model—the novel was channeled or written by Zebra itself.
'Maze of Death' exemplifies the theme of the real thrusting into the irreal, serving as narrative confirmation of Model B.
PKD's writing itself—'piling trash upon trash' (following Lem)—functions as gutter-level gadfly like Socrates, an unlikely vessel for encountering the Holy.

All of PKD's 27 years of writing have unconsciously circled around: plural worlds, world-as-hallucination, masters behind reality, and the ubiquitous penetrating wisdom-entity—suggesting Zebra was always the hidden subject of his fiction.
symbols_images: The cold-pac (cold-sleep chamber) in Ubik—the cryogenic pod housing consciousness being fed false stimuli, metaphor for human immobilization.
Runciter penetrating the cold-pac world—image of higher intelligence invading lower realm to reveal illusory nature of perceived reality.
One-way intrusions—unilateral breaks into closed systems, traffic flowing 'from the other side' without visible return portal.
Crosshatching—billions of worlds interlocking diagonally, vertically, horizontally like brain-cell switchboards; the pattern of God's providence.
Trash strata / gutter—low, unexpected places where Zebra's sacred epiphanies occur; the paradox of finding God in refuse.
Synchronized inner-outer tapes—mechanical tracks running parallel, representing the dual control (immobilized brain receiving site-stimulation).
Camouflage—Zebra's intrusions masked as normal events, preventing detection of the uncanny (unlike Ubik's overt commercial messages).
The ceramic pot (Oh Ho)—Zen image of the oracle speaking from humble vessel.
Yin-yang—dialectic opposition of two powers within time, harmonized as single tao outside time.
The False Work—the entire Form II realm abolished retroactively in 3-74, as PKD saw in his vision and alluded to in his Metz speech.
tensions: Is Zebra's 3-74 xerox-missive response an abrogation of normal (subliminal) mechanism or an intensification of it? PKD cannot decide whether the response was programmed-but-overridden or programmed-at-a-higher-level.

If the Black Iron Prison yoked humanity into billions of simulated worlds, is that system itself the enemy, or is it a necessary growth stage? PKD gestures toward historical necessity but remains ambiguous.
PKD claims to 'presume neither monism nor monotheism,' yet he identifies the logos with God and speaks of rescue—a tension between epistemic caution and theological confidence.
The Logos is said to 'contest with its own antecedent (fossil remnant) self'—a paradox: is the Logos fighting its own past, or fighting the old system it once inhabited?
PKD states Zebra is 'benign' yet also describes it as a fierce invading force attacking our universe—tone shifts between salvific and violently intrusive.
If all push-pull worlds must contain synchronized clocks for interaction, how does this mechanical constraint align with the creative agency of the sentient logos?

PKD writes that 'Although I often write about the irreal (or hallucinated) world crowding out the real, the facts are exactly opposite'—a reversal of his previous framework suggesting unresolved evolution in his thinking.
evidence_quotes: It is precisely the set/ground discrimination which I had briefly in 3-74 which is, for us, totally lacking. Now the importance - + the logic - of that at-the-time-surprising set/ground discrimination can be appreciated.
The coherence of the total system depends on a master plan which I identify with the logos; the master plan itself is alive + thinks; the totality is (like) a God itself ('Kai theos en ho logos').
We have a life form growing within something which itself is less than a life form exhibiting (the latter) mere blind causality + chance - i.e. Chaos (c.f. Empedocles + the idea of krasis).
Instead of seeking God we are sought for _by_ God (Zebra).
uncertainty_flags: Who exactly is 'Lem'? Likely Stanislaw Lem (SF author of Memoirs Found in a Bathtub), but not explicitly named. The referenced paradigm of immobilized brain site-stimulation may be paraphrased rather than direct.
The 'xerox missive response' from 3-74: PKD never clarifies what the missive said, what response he gave, or how it constituted programming override. Scholars remain uncertain about the referent.
What are the 'synchronized inner-outer tapes'? PKD mentions them as mechanical, running inflexibly, but their exact nature and location remain unclear.
Does 'Tears' (referenced as Zebra info riding through) refer to a specific event, person, location, or work? Context suggests a communication channel but identity is opaque.
The 'false work' abolished retroactively in 3-74: PKD alludes to his Metz speech but does not spell out what was abolished or how the retroactive aspect functions.
Is Model B truly new or a recognition of what was latent in Ubik? PKD oscillates between discovery and recovery, suggesting some theological confusion about his own originality.
The claim that space is 'irreal' rests on Zebra's intrusions having no detectable 'other side in physical space'—but this may be a logical non-sequitur (absence of evidence ≠ unreality of space).

Then the immobilized brains undergoing selective site stimulation are imprisoned + deceived as it stands. I can presume neither monism nor monotheism, but I can presume - I have seen - rescue (freedom). I am right about model B, but it is more complex than I had realized, + a fierce dialectic fight is involved. folder 02 - 047 folder 02 - 047 The brain is new - dating from Acts. Parole: it liberates us by incorporating us.
